verses.text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.

segments.text: Give ear to my prayer, O God;
And hide not thyself from my supplication.

verses.text: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

segments.text: Attend unto me, and answer me:
I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

verses.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.

segments.text: Because of the voice of the enemy,
Because of the oppression of the wicked;
For they cast iniquity upon me,
And in anger they persecute me.

verses.text: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

segments.text: My heart is sore pained within me:
And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.

segments.text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me,
And horror hath overwhelmed me.

verses.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

segments.text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove!
Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

verses.text: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. [Selah

segments.text: Lo, then would I wander far off,
I would lodge in the wilderness. [Selah

verses.text: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.

segments.text: I would haste me to a shelter
From the stormy wind and tempest.

verses.text: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

segments.text: Destroy, O Lord,
and
divide their tongue;
For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

segments.text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof:
Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

verses.text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.

segments.text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof:
Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.

verses.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:

segments.text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me;
Then I could have borne it:
Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me;
Then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.

segments.text: But it was thou, a man mine equal,
My companion, and my familiar friend.

verses.text: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.

segments.text: We took sweet counsel together;
We walked in the house of God with the throng.

verses.text: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

segments.text: Let death come suddenly upon them,
Let them go down alive into Sheol;
For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

verses.text: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.

segments.text: As for me, I will call upon God;
And Jehovah will save me.

verses.text: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.

segments.text: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan;
And he will hear my voice.

verses.text: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many that strove with me.

segments.text: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me;
For they were many
that strove
with me.

verses.text: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, [Selah The men who have no changes, And who fear not God.

segments.text: God will hear, and answer them,
Even he that abideth of old, [Selah
The men
who have no changes,
And who fear not God.

verses.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.

segments.text: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him:
He hath profaned his covenant.

verses.text: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.

segments.text: His mouth was smooth as butter,
But his heart was war:
His words were softer than oil,
Yet were they drawn swords.

verses.text: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

segments.text: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee:
He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.text: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee.

segments.text: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction:

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. Maschil of David.
